thread:
devon: Quick help — customer reporting intermittent 403s when calling our webhook endpoint from their on‑prem firewall. They say source IPs keep changing.

lina: Are they NAT-ing through a pool? We rotate SNATs for outbound egress, so IPs can change across requests, especially when requests land on different nodes :grimacing: 

rajiv: Short summary: if they're doing strict IP allowlists they need either a stable egress IP (Dedicated or static NAT) or allow by FQDN + TLS SNI. Otherwise you'll see hits from multiple source IPs.

maria: Also check TLS inspection. If their perimeter proxy does MITM TLS, SNI can be stripped and certs replaced — that breaks hostname-based allow rules. Ask them to allow TLS passthrough for our domains or allow our IP ranges.

sam: Quick debug tips for them:
- curl -v https://webhook.redwood-inference.net/ --connect-to webhook.redwood-inference.net:443:our-node-ip:443
- openssl s_client -connect webhook.redwood-inference.net:443 -servername webhook.redwood-inference.net

lina: Also note: long-lived connections can drop because of NAT idle timeouts. If they maintain TCP firewall state aggressively, recommend enabling keepalives or app-level heartbeats (ping every 30s).

devon: Any guidance on ports to whitelist? they only want to open a small set.

rajiv: They only need to allow outbound TCP to destination ports 443 and 80. Source ports are ephemeral — server doesn't require a specific source port. If they have proxy that only permits CONNECT to 443, that should be fine.

maria: If they must whitelist IPs, give them these hostnames to resolve regularly: webhook.redwood-inference.net, api.redwood-inference.net, streaming.redwood-inference.net. IPs can change across AZs/regions.

ops-bot: deploy finished: rolling egress pool update deployed to us-west-2 at 1958112500

sam: If they want fixed IPs we can offer Dedicated pools (reserved egress) or advise using a customer-side static NAT gateway that peers with our VPC — that avoids frequent IP churn but is higher cost.

devon: I'll send the customer a short checklist w/ the curl commands and the hostnames. Thanks team :thumbsup:
